card.name: Three-part words: ternary, triadic, tripartite
card.fires_on: Parts of words meaning three-way or involving three parts, such as tern|ary, tri|adic, tri|part|ite and tri|somy. It fires on the ending or middle of these words, mostly in science and politics text.

modes.label: Ternary and triadic
modes.description: The ending of words for three-component systems in chemistry or social science.
modes.example: assembly of tern<<ary>> supermolecules with predictable and desired connectivity

modes.label: Tripartite
modes.description: The middle or start of tripartite, meaning split among three parties.
modes.example: The treaty superseded the tri<<part>>ite division of the empire in 8

modes.label: Trisomy and triad
modes.description: The tri start or the word three in terms about triplets or three copies.
modes.example: there are<< three>> sex chromosomes in the body's cells instead

card.writes: It pushes toward words like intermediate and intermediary, a middle or third-party sense, and away from words about two parties such as 'both sides' and 'each other'.
card.plain: It lights up on words meaning three-way, like ternary, triadic or tripartite, as the word is being spelled out.
